معدات:Closed Cooling Water Pump
 ABRBN "Centrifugal Pumps"
 Audoli & Berrtola Italy

This document outlines 
the major maintenance procedures P1, to be performed every five years as 
indicated by Y5 in the title block.

ال
closed cooling pumps function to circulate the cooling water using for 
cooling the matrix components. They obtain from the compensation tank the water 
which flow to cool the components of the unit, pass to the heat exchanger and 
return to the pumps again in a closed circle

The first draft is initiated by eng. Mohamed Abdel Azeem, 
reviewed by eng. Ahmed Fathy Yousef, tested by eng. 
Esam Hassan Darwesh, revised by eng. 
Samir Abdel Gelil: EDEPC inspection and quality control general director, 
accepted by eng. Mohamed Farag Anan: general manager, and approved by eng. 
Mohamed El-Sarrag: head sector of Damietta (3x135MW) PS.

تم قبول هذه الوثيقة من قبل المهندس.

 predicting head sector and supervisor of inspection & 
 quality control's head sector.

The maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.
Isolate the CB of the pump motor.

Disconnect electric terminals of the pump 
 motor.

Isolate the pump mechanically by closing the 
 suction and delivery valves.
